prompt: Retell this small incident from the shopkeeper's point of view: 'Mara entered to escape the rain. She examined a cracked ceramic bird but bought only a postcard. Before leaving, she placed the bird where its unbroken side faced the door.' Please answer in roughly 80 words.
text: Mara slipped into my shop with the rain at her heels, shaking droplets from her coat. I watched her linger over the cracked ceramic bird, turning it carefully in her hands as though deciding whether its damage mattered. In the end, she brought only a postcard to the counter. Before stepping back into the downpour, she returned to the shelf and quietly turned the bird around, leaving its unbroken side facing the door. Somehow, the little thing looked proud again.
